verdict: Amazon's sales rose 13% to $167.7B and profit jumped 35% to $18.2B as AWS grew 17% and every segment earned more — but free cash flow is shrinking as spending on AI data centers surges.

follow100Note: AWS is only $18.41 of every $100 of sales, but it produces over half of Amazon's operating profit. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
otherDetail: Total non-operating income of $1,686M: $1,117M of other income, plus $1,085M of interest income less $516M of interest expense. Equity-method activity took off another $15M after tax.

takeaways.title: AWS growth picked up
takeaways.text: AWS sales grew 17% to $30.9B and the unit earned $10.2B — more than half of Amazon's total operating income comes from the cloud.

takeaways.title: Profit grew far faster than sales
takeaways.text: Net income jumped 35% to $18.2B. International operating income rose more than fivefold to $1.5B as the overseas stores got more efficient.

takeaways.title: Free cash flow is shrinking
takeaways.text: Free cash flow over the last twelve months fell to $18.2B, from $53.0B a year earlier — Amazon is pouring cash into AI data centers and warehouses faster than the business generates it.
